important_objects.reason: Primary point for cheese tasting and purchase, central to visitor interaction.
Key interactive exhibit demonstrating traditional cheese pressing.
Interactive cheese-making machine allowing hands-on visitor engagement.
Tactile exploration table for educational interaction.
First contact point for visitor orientation and brand introduction.
Life-size exhibit connecting visitors to dairy farming origins.
Historic vehicle exhibit illustrating milk delivery heritage.
Defines lounge area for visitor comfort and socializing.

interaction_topics.title: Cheese Making Process
interaction_topics.description: Explanation and demonstration of traditional and modern cheese production techniques using the cheese press and kettle.

interaction_topics.title: Dairy Farming and Milk Supply
interaction_topics.description: Educational content about dairy farming, milk collection, and delivery showcased by the dairy cow model and vintage milk truck.

interaction_topics.title: Steinpilz Brand Story
interaction_topics.description: Introduction to the Steinpilz brand, its heritage, and values presented at the welcome counter.

interaction_topics.title: Tactile Cheese Exploration
interaction_topics.description: Interactive tactile experiences related to cheese textures, materials, and sensory learning at the central touch table.

agent_role_candidates.mission: Greet visitors, provide orientation, and introduce the Steinpilz brand and experience room.
Demonstrate cheese making techniques, assist visitors with interactive equipment, and explain production processes.
Educate visitors about dairy farming, milk supply, and the agricultural heritage of Steinpilz.
Facilitate tactile and sensory learning experiences at the exploration table and support visitor interaction.
Maintain a comfortable and welcoming lounge environment, assist visitors in relaxation and socializing.
